age.evidence: Male Sprague Dawley rats (Rattus norvegicus), weighing 200-250 g

dosing.evidence: In DOI experiments, DOI (10 µM) was present in the continuously perfused recording aCSF.

group_housing.evidence: Animals were individually housed, with food and water available ad libitum in the home cage.

day_night_flipped.evidence: A 12 h light/dark cycle was used with the lights on at 7 A.M.

judge_notes: This study contains no behavioural assays. All experiments are ex vivo slice electrophysiology (whole-cell patch-clamp recordings of CLA-ACC neurons) measuring synaptic plasticity (LTP/LTD) and intrinsic AP properties. Per rubric, electrophysiology recordings are explicitly excluded from scoring.
DOI was bath-applied to brain slices (10 µM in aCSF), not administered systemically to behaving rodents. Route coded as 'other' (bath application) and vehicle as 'other' (aCSF).
All three candidates agreed there are no scorable behavioural assays; assays array is empty.
